fieldInfo.documentation:
Provides a list of the index members that constitute an index along with its percentage weight.

Equity Indices:
For each constituent the output includes ticker with exchange code and member percentage weight. This field will return a maximum of 5,000 members.

Commodity Indices:
For each constituent the output includes the commodity contract along with its weight within the index.

Provides a list of all equity index members along with the percentage weight of each constituent within the index. Applies to indices with up to 5,000 members.

Bloomberg API and Terminal: Historical member weights can be retrieved by using this field in conjunction with the End Date (DS547, END_DT) or End Date Override (PX392, END_DATE_OVERRIDE).

Provides a list of all members of an index along with the weight of each within the index. Returns the first 3,000 sorted in alphabetical order. The output includes the ticker followed by its respective weight within the index. For indices with more than 3,000 members, use Page Number Override (DW300, PAGE_NUMBER_OVERRIDE) to view subsequent pages. This field is not support on indices with more than 20,000 members.

Historical member shares can be retrieved by utilizing this field in conjunction with the date override field End Date (DS547, END_DT), Number Of Days Ago (PR429, NUM_DAYS_AGO), End Date Override (PX392, END_DATE_OVERRIDE).

Display Financial Instrument Global ID Override (ID158, DISPLAY_ID_BB_GLOBAL_OVERRIDE) can be used to have this field return Financial Instrument Global Identifiers (FIGI).

Provides a list of the equity members that constitute an index. For each constituent the output includes the equity member with exchange code, percentage weight, share count and the last price. This field will return members 701-1,400 sorted alphabetically by ticker. For indices with less than 700 members refer to Index Members Weight / Prices - 700 Members Max (DS258,INDX_MWEIGHT_PX).

Display Financial Instrument Global ID Override (ID158, DISPLAY_ID_BB_GLOBAL_OVERRIDE) can be used to have this field return Financial Instrument Global Identifiers (FIGI).

Display Financial Instrument Global ID Override (ID158, DISPLAY_ID_BB_GLOBAL_OVERRIDE) can be used to have this field return Financial Instrument Global Identifiers (FIGI).

This field will return members 1,401-2,100 sorted alphabetically by ticker. For member count 1-700 refer to Index Members Weight / Prices - 700 Members Max (DS258,INDX_MWEIGHT_PX). For member count 701-1,400 refer to Index Members Weights (DX589, INDX_MWEIGHT_PX2).

Provides the official MSCI index members and weights. This field returns a list of all the equity members of the MSCI index along with the % weight of each within the index. This field will return the first 1000 members.

Percentage weight of the stock in the index. The field will return the weight of the security in its relative index. To find the relative index for a security you must refer to Relative Index (PR240, REL_INDEX). To find the weighting of the security in an index other then the relative index, Relative Index must be overridden with a different index.  If the return value is N.A., use Index List (DS428, INDX_LIST) to see a list of indices the security is a member of, which can be used to override Relative Index (PR240, REL_INDEX).
   Index Weight = (Equity price * Shares) / (Index price * Divisor)

   Historical Index Weight = (Equity price * Shares) / SUM(Equity_price_i * share_i)

Provides a list of the official MSCI index members and weights. This field returns a list of all the equity members of the index along with the percentage weight of each within the index as well as the price used to calculate the weighting. The first column is the ticker, the second column is the percentage weight, the third column is the actual weight (same as outstanding shares), and the fourth column is the current price of the security in USD. This field will return the first 700 members sorted alphabetically by ticker.

Returns a list of relative indices that the security is a member of along with the percentage weight within the index and the price of the index.  The returned list will return a maximum of 236 indices.
Returns a list of column headers for Index Member Weights (DS424, INDX_MWEIGHT) using standard data elements or bulk column names.

Provides the index estimated earnings for the current fiscal year based on the BEst estimate for each member. Calculated by summing all members' BEst EPS for FY1 (BE008, BEST_EPS) times shares in the index, divided by the index divisor (IN018, INDX_DIVISOR).
The MSCI official number of shares outstanding of the security in the index used in the calculation of the end-of-day index member weights and valuation ratios.

Median amount of freight hauled per workday for all members of an index. The underlying value at the company level is Average Weight per Workday (M0317, AVERAGE_WEIGHT_PER_WORKDAY). Calculation of this field differs from standard index calculation in that it is a median value. 

Field is available exclusively for Bloomberg Industries indices.

Median amount of freight hauled per shipment for all members of an index. The underlying value at the company level is Trucking-Average Load (FS909, TRUCKING_AVG_LOAD). Calculation of this field differs from standard index calculation in that it is a median value.

Field is available exclusively for Bloomberg Industries indices.

fieldInfo.description: 871M QI Individual US Sourced Weighting Test
fieldInfo.documentation:
Indicates whether the index in question passed (Y) or failed (N) the Individual Index Member United States (US) Sourced Percentage Weighting sub-test section of the Qualified Index classification test as described in the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) regulation Section 871(m). 'Y' return indicates the index passed this threshold test, 'N' return indicates the index failed this threshold test, and 'N/A' indicates test was unable to be performed do to lack of data availability.

Note that Bloomberg has not performed a complete tax analysis of any instrument in question. Each subscriber should consult its own tax advisor for advice and analysis regarding the proper United States (US) federal income tax treatment of any particular instrument.

Heparin low molecular weight (LMW) sales, aggregated for all members of an index. Calculation of this field differs from standard index calculation in that it is a sum. Field is available exclusively for Bloomberg Industries indices.

Number of pages for browsing large indices that contains more than 3,000 members. Each page contains 3,000 members sorted alphabetically by name. Default value is 1.

This is used as a override field to set the page for the following fields:
Index Members Shares (DW299, INDEX_MEMBERS_SHARES),
Index Members Weights (DW364,INDEX_MEMBERS_WEIGHTS)

Railroad Gross Ton Miles (GTM) aggregated for all members of an index. Gross ton miles measure movement of total train weight over a distance of one mile. The underlying value at the company level is Gross Ton Miles (M0298, GROSS_TON_MILES). Calculation of this field differs from standard index calculation in that it is a sum.

Field is available exclusively for Bloomberg Industries indices.

Revenue Ton Miles (RTM) aggregated for all members of an index. Revenue ton miles are calculated by multiplying the weight of freight by the number of miles transported. The underlying value at the company level is Revenue Ton Miles (M0947, REVENUE_TON_MILES). Calculation of this field differs from standard index calculation in that it is a sum.

Field is available exclusively for Bloomberg Industries indices.

Risk weighted assets aggregated for all members of an index. The underlying value at the company level is Risk-Weighted Assets (BS513, BS_RISK_WEIGHTED_ASSETS). Calculation of this field differs from standard index calculation in that it is a sum. Field is available exclusively for Bloomberg Industries indices.
